_comment: The v1 passage set. Target is 25-50, chosen for genuine scholarly dispute as much as familiarity. This starter set is the five passages the project handoff already has real content for: the koinonia thread.

passages.why: The prototype's centre verse. Devotion, fellowship, breaking of bread, prayer.
James and John as Simon's koinonoi - his fishing-trade partners. Grounds koinonia in commerce.
Partnership in the gospel. Reads differently once the business sense is known.
koinos as 'unclean' - the same root as koinonia, opposite valence.
Peter: 'nothing unclean'. The koinos tension no Bible app surfaces.
